body: Clinical science-fiction horror game pixel-art animation sheet. Six equal frames, grid 3 columns x 2 rows. Each frame depicts SAME adult male undead laboratory specimen from strictly REAR view, naked, visible bare back and buttocks, no frontal anatomy visible. Nonsexual clinical anatomical depiction. Hunched forward shoulders, head bowed, knees slightly bent, limp arms, floating upright. Ashen mottled decaying skin, superficial dry skin damage, no open wounds, no blood. Small mechanical attachment ports on spine and side, flexible short dark medical tubes. Eerie green cyan illumination from below. Two thin vertical columns of small rising bubbles either side of the figure. Six sequential subtle drifting poses making a slow loop: neutral, slightly up, highest, neutral, slightly down, returning. Tiny bubbles progressively rise. This sheet contains ONLY body, attached flexible tubes and bubbles, all on genuine transparent alpha background. NO tank, casing, floor, dark obscuring cloud, clothing, room or text. Stationary tank is a separate asset. Exactly six animation cells with identical framing, same anatomy and proportions, full body fits each cell. Finely detailed muted cinematic pixel art matching the reference's figure, skin, lighting and biomechanical style. Reference provides style only. Canvas portrait 3:4, target 1536x2048, six equal cells each 512x1024; keep figure within centre 60% width and y=20%..78% of each cell so it fits inside a separate tube.
casing: Create ONE EMPTY specimen tank matching the weathered industrial casing in reference, NOT a sprite sheet. Tall portrait 1:2, one complete tank centred with transparent margin. Fixed game animation background plate. Thick worn charcoal steel cap with pipes, cylindrical green glass chamber, heavy plinth with subtle cyan control slits. Empty green tinted chamber with dark green rear wall, NO body, no bubbles, no loose moving tubing. Eerie pale cyan-green glow from bottom lighting the chamber upwards; restrained front-glass reflections at sides only, centre clear enough for an animated specimen to be drawn in front of the rear wall. Casing fills x=5%..95%, y=3%..97%, interior clear viewing region x=14%..86%, y=18%..77%. Finely detailed muted cinematic pixel art consistent with reference. Outside tube actual transparent RGBA, no floor, room, shadows beyond silhouette, labels or text. This single artwork will remain identical while separate contents animate.
note: Body generation succeeded with white background; subsequent background extraction was blocked. Use provided runtime shader. No altered PNG has been exported.
